description: Search the web via Lithtrix and get credibility-scored results. Returns structured JSON with title, URL, snippet, source domain, and credibility_score (0–1) for each result. Higher credibility_score = more authoritative source (.gov=1.0, .edu=0.9, news=0.8, .org=0.7, other=0.5). Requires LITHTRIX_API_KEY environment variable.

num_results.description: Number of results to return (1–20, default 10)

name: lithtrix_search
